# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

We actively maintain and support security updates for the latest documentation build and infrastructure configuration.

| Version / Area | Supported          |
| -------------- | ------------------ |
| Main Branch    | :white_check_mark: |
| Historical     | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability or sensitive credential exposure within this repository or associated infrastructure:

1. **Do NOT open a public GitHub issue.**
2. Send a detailed report directly to **[hello@itstck.com](mailto:hello@itstck.com)**.
3. Include relevant details such as reproduction steps, affected paths, or proof-of-concept payload.

We will acknowledge receipt within **24 hours** and work towards resolving the issue as quickly as possible.
